name: std::flat_multiset<Key,Compare,KeyContainer>::insert_range

declarations.code:
template <container - compatible - range<value_type> R>

void insert_range(R &&rg);

intro:
Inserts a copy of each element in the range rg into underlying container c as if by:

for (const auto& e : rg)
    c.insert(c.end(), e);

Then, sorts the range of newly inserted elements with respect to compare.
Merges the resulting sorted range and the sorted range of pre-existing elements into a single sorted range.

Each iterator in the range rg is dereferenced exactly once.
The behavior is undefined if rg overlaps with the container.

Information on iterator invalidation is copied from here

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
rg

 -

 a container compatible range, that is, an input_range whose elements are convertible to T

sections.title: Complexity
sections.text: N + M·log(M), where N is size() before the operation and M is ranges::distance(rg).

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: Since insert_range performs an in-place merge operation, that may allocate memory.
